## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change belongs in this package.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has an observable regression test
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are reflected in README and `docs/API.md`
- [ ] A non-obvious call is recorded in `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] Breaking changes use a Conventional Commit `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer

## Compatibility

List behavior changes, migration needs, or write “No compatibility impact.”
